Criterion: Verify that provisions are available to shut off flammable fluids and de-energize all electrical ignition sources in the identified fire zone(s) for all mission phases including ground operations. Standard: Shutoff valves are provided that can close off all flammable fluids to fire zones during a fire. All electrical equipment in a fire zone can be de-energized to prevent further ignition of flammable fluids. Method of Compliance: Ground tests verify that the closing of any of the fuel shutoff valves does not affect fuel availability to the remaining propulsion system, if applicable. Drawing inspections and component tests verify that each flammable fluid shut-off means and controls are fireproof or protected from a fire or fire zone. Ground test verify all electrical equipment in fire zones are able to be de-energized in case of a fire.
